title: Design WhatsApp Web
definition: WhatsApp Web requires robust WebSocket architecture for real-time messaging, local IndexedDB storage for offline viewing and caching massive chat histories, and End-to-End Encryption (Web Crypto API).
simpleExplanation: A chat app that must instantly receive messages, store them permanently on your local hard drive, and encrypt them so nobody else can read them.

basic: What are the core requirements for WhatsApp Web?
intermediate: How do you handle edge cases and accessibility in WhatsApp Web?
advanced: How do you scale and optimize WhatsApp Web for millions of concurrent users?
trick: What happens to WhatsApp Web if JavaScript is disabled?

answers.question: Define WhatsApp Web.
answers.answer: A complex system design problem requiring deep architectural knowledge.
